verdict.rationale: GitBook's official MCP server lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients create and configure sites, open change requests, draft content, edit pages and restructure docs through natural-language agent instructions. The docs explicitly promote 'drive it from your agent', and the first-party GitBook Agent drafts improvements and reviews change requests. missing for 10: a documented first-party natural-language command interface for general product operation (the main path relies on an external MCP-client agent), detail on the scope of GitBook Agent's command handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
